statusDefinitions.PREPRINT: Public manuscript available before peer-reviewed journal publication.
statusDefinitions.MANUSCRIPT: Research manuscript; not presented as peer-reviewed publication.
statusDefinitions.VERIFIED: Evidence independently or issuer-verified as specified.
statusDefinitions.LEARNING DIRECTION: Area of study or technical direction; not claimed expertise.
statusDefinitions.PROTOTYPE: Implemented prototype; not presented as production deployment.
statusDefinitions.ACCEPTED: Formally accepted by the stated venue or programme; publication/enrolment is a separate later state.
statusDefinitions.MAINTAINED: Completed enough for use and still being maintained.
